units.text: In Wealth, this chapter favours a clear budget over a bigger income, and you sleep better once every bill has a name and a date.
In Love, this chapter favours evenings together over plans for more, and you find a partner values your time above anything you bring home.
In Health, this chapter favours a busy day over a long lie-in, and you feel most awake when your hands have real work in them.
In Health, this chapter favours an early night over one more errand, and you get your appetite back once the list stops growing.
In your thinking, this chapter favours practical problems over theory, and you learn fastest from something you can test the same week.
In your thinking, this chapter favours a quiet hour over a crowded diary, and you see your choices clearly only when nothing is calling for your attention.
In Growth, this chapter favours learning on the job over learning from a book, and you pick up new skills by taking on tasks just beyond you.
In Growth, this chapter favours depth over another new venture, and you gain more from mastering what you already hold than from adding to it.
In Career, this chapter favours a title with clear duties over a free hand, and you earn trust by meeting every deadline set for you.
In Wealth, this chapter favours a steady salary over a gamble, and you build your savings on the regular pay that a firm role brings.
In Wealth, this chapter favours money you control over money tied to someone else's terms, and you breathe easier with fewer loans and contracts in your name.
In Love, this chapter favours a partner with firm plans over a drifting one, and you feel safest when the two of you agree on the rules of the house.
At home, this chapter favours set routines over loose ones, and you become the one the household turns to when a decision is due.
At home, this chapter favours fewer house rules over tighter ones, and you ease the pressure by letting small things slide.
With friends, this chapter favours people who turn up on time over people who keep you amused, and you gain standing in groups that have a purpose.
With friends, this chapter favours easy company over clubs with duties, and you recover from a demanding week among people who expect nothing formal of you.
In Health, this chapter favours a fixed bedtime over late nights, and you have more energy once your meals and sleep run to a schedule.
In your thinking, this chapter favours a clear method over loose ideas, and you think best with a goal and a deadline in front of you.
In your thinking, this chapter favours your own judgement over other people's expectations, and you settle your mind with reading done for its own sake.
In Growth, this chapter favours a formal course over teaching yourself, and you rise fastest when someone senior tests what you know.
In Growth, this chapter favours learning at your own pace over chasing the next grade, and you grow most where nobody is marking you.
